items.text: Business development means finding new customers, partners or markets and turning conversations into deals, and the career grows from outreach and research to account ownership, partnerships and a revenue leadership role by building a documented pipeline.
Learn to research prospects, write short messages, hold useful conversations and keep a clean pipeline record.
Ask how targets are set and what support you receive.
